_readme: Each key below fills one slot on the page. Put a full URL (https://...) or a path relative to index.html (e.g. images/edgeos.jpg) in src. Leave src empty to show the placeholder. focus sets which part of the image stays in frame when cropped (CSS object-position, e.g. '50% 20%' keeps the top). video is optional and only used by the showreel slot.

edgeos.alt: EdgeOS workspace with the AI co-pilot panel open

catalysis23.alt: Catalysis23 event with founders on stage

showreel.ratio: 16:9 landscape. src is the still/poster; video (mp4) plays muted on loop if set
